about: The angel continues to Solomon: the saviour’s line is a pearl, created in Adam’s womb before Eve and passed down from Seth through Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, Judah, Jesse, David and Solomon, each time bypassing the proud or erring firstborn for the humble, until it comes to Jeroboam’s line so that the saviour can be crucified and descend to Sheol. All who carried the pearl, men and women, are promised salvation.

sentences.n: Chapter heading. ፷፰ is 60 + 8 (Ethiopic numerals, tens then ones; here no ወ- ‘and’ is written between them, unlike ፷ወ፯ in ch. 67). በእንተ ‘concerning’ takes a noun. መድኀኒትነ is መድኀኒት ‘salvation, saviour’ + -ነ ‘our’ (a suffix, not a construct); ‘our saviour Mary’, a title for Mary, is also possible (?). The speaker is presumably the angel of the Lord of ch. 67, still addressing Solomon (?).

sentences.i: And again, let it be a sign to you that a saviour will come from your seed, and that he will save you, together with your fathers and your seed after you, at his coming.
sentences.n: ወካዕበ = ወ- ‘and’ + ካዕበ ‘again’. ይኩንከ = ይኩን (3ms subjunctive of ኮነ ‘be’, used as a jussive ‘let it be’) + -ከ ‘to you’; ትእምርተ ‘sign’ is the accusative predicate. ከመ + ይመጽእ: ከመ ‘that’ takes the subjunctive (3ms subjunctive of መጽአ ‘come’), and ወከመ ያድኅንከ continues it: ያድኅን (3ms subjunctive) is the causative (አ-stem) of ድኅነ ‘be safe’, i.e. ‘save’, + -ከ ‘you’. ወዘርእከ ‘and your seed’ is joined to the group that is saved (reading from context (?)). እምድኅሬከ = እም- ‘from’ + ድኅሬ ‘after’ + -ከ. በምጽአቱ = በ- ‘at, in’ + ምጽአት ‘coming’ + -ሁ ‘his’.

sentences.n: ተፈጥረት is the passive (tä-stem) of ፈጠረ ‘create’, 3fs perfect, agreeing with the feminine noun መድኀኒት (spelled መደኀኒትክሙ here, with -ክሙ ‘your’, plural). ከርሠ is the construct of ከርሥ ‘womb, belly’; ዕንቈ is the construct of ዕንቍ ‘stone, gem’, so ዕንቈ ባሕርይ ‘jewel-of pearl’, a pearl-stone (house: ዕንቍ ‘jewel, precious stone’, ባሕርይ ‘pearl’). ‘The pearl’ (ባሕርይ) is the image running through the whole chapter for the line of descent that carries the future saviour. እምቅድመ = እም- ‘from’ + ቅድመ ‘before, prior to’; ‘from before’ is idiomatically ‘before’.

sentences.i: When he created Eve from the bone of Adam’s side and said to them, “Increase,” the pearl did not go out from Adam’s womb to Cain and Abel; it went out from Adam’s womb to the third son, and returned into the womb of Seth;
sentences.n: ፈጠራ = ፈጠረ ‘created’ + -ኣ ‘her’, with ለሔዋን repeating the object; likewise ገቦሁ ለአዳም ‘his side, (that) of Adam’ and ከርሡ ለሴት ‘his womb, (that) of Seth’ — a common Geʿez way to express ‘of’ with a pronoun placed first. ወይቤሎሙ = ወ- + ይቤ ‘he said’ + -ሎሙ ‘to them’. ብዝኁ is the 2mp imperative of በዝኀ ‘be many’, echoing Genesis 1:28 (‘be fruitful and multiply’); I take the quotation to end there and what follows to be a new statement (?). ወፅአት ‘it went out’ and ገብአት ‘it returned’ (house sense; ‘came back into’ the line of Seth) are 3fs perfects with ባሕርይ understood as the subject. ኀበ ‘to, toward’; ሣልስ ‘third’ is Seth (Genesis 4:25), after Cain and Abel.

sentences.n: እንዘ + imperfect (ተሐውር, 3fs of ሖረ ‘go’) = ‘while going’; ይእቲ ‘she’ restates the subject, ባሕርይ ‘the pearl’. እለ ኮኑ በኵረ = ‘those who were (as) firstborn’ (በኵረ accusative). በጽሐት ‘it reached’ (3fs perfect). The pattern that runs through the next units is set here: the pearl goes to each generation in turn but passes over some firstborn sons and rests with a worthier one.

sentences.i: Then the pearl waited and did not go to your firstborn, for the men of his city are good: if they did not deny him and did not crucify him, like Israel your people (?), when they see the one who works wonders, who is born of the pearl, they, for their part, will believe in him on hearing the report of him;
sentences.n: The sense is compressed and I have read it as: the pearl did not go to Solomon’s firstborn because his people are good and would believe, whereas the saviour must be crucified, which the next lines draw out (?). እመ ኢክሕድዎ ‘if they did not deny him’ and እመ ኢሰቀልዎ ‘if they did not crucify him’ are 3mp perfects with -ኦ ‘him’ after እመ ‘if’ + ኢ- ‘not’; I read them as a protasis (‘if they did not deny … or crucify …’) whose apodosis is እሙንቱሰ የአምኑ ‘they will believe’ (?). ሀገሩ ‘his city’ (whose city is not stated (?)). ይሬእዩ is the 3mp imperfect of ርእየ ‘see’. ክሕደ ‘deny’ and ሰቀለ ‘crucify’ have the object -ኦ ‘him’ (here -ዎ). ዘይገብር ተኣምረ = ዘ- ‘who’ + 3ms imperfect ‘does, works’ + ተኣምረ ‘wonder, sign’ (accusative). ዘይትወለድ ‘who is born’ (tä-stem). እሙንቱሰ ‘they indeed’ (-ሰ marks contrast). በሰሚዐ = በ- ‘by’ + the infinitive ሰሚዐ ‘hearing’; ዜናሁ ‘his report’. Compare Romans 10:17 on faith from hearing.

sentences.i: Nor did it go to the younger one, your son Adrami (?), since they are good: if they did not crucify him and did not deny him when they saw the one who works wonders and marvels, who is born of the pearl, then in the end they will believe in him through his disciples.
sentences.n: ዘይንእስኒ = ዘ- ‘the one who’ + ይንእስ ‘is young’ + -ኒ ‘also’, so ‘the younger one’. አድራሚ is unexplained: a name, or a corrupt word; I leave it as ‘Adrami’ (?). እሙን ፡ ቱ is divided by a wordspace in the printed text; I read it as እሙንቱ ‘they are’ (?), as in the previous unit, and so do not render ‘faithful’; read as two words (እሙን ‘faithful’ + a stray ቱ) the sense would add ‘faithful and good’ (?). ኢሰቀልዎ is a 3mp perfect + -ኦ ‘him’. ኢክሕዲ again has the -ዲ ending for 3mp (see the note on ይትወለዲ). ርእዩ ‘they saw’ (3mp perfect of ርእየ). መንክር ‘marvel’. ወበደኃሪ ‘and afterward’. የአምኑ ቦቱ ‘they will believe in him’ (3mp imperfect of አምነ, with በ- + -ቱ ‘in him’). በአርድእቱ ‘through his disciples’ (አርድእት, plural of ረድእ ‘disciple’, + -ሁ).

sentences.i: But nevertheless the pearl went out from your womb, which will be your salvation, and entered the womb of Jeroboam your son, because of the evil of Israel your people; for through their denial and their evil they will crucify him;
sentences.n: አላ ባሕቱ ‘but nevertheless’. እንተ is the feminine relative ‘which’, with ትከውን ‘she will be’ (3fs imperfect of ኮነ) and the predicate መድኀኒተክሙ ‘your salvation’ (accusative, -ክሙ ‘your’ plural). The text names Jeroboam as Solomon’s son here, where 1 Kings 12 has Rehoboam; I keep the name as written. እከዮሙ = እከይ ‘evil’ + -ሆሙ ‘their’; ለእስራኤል marks the possessor (‘the evil of Israel’). ወበ ፡ እከዮሙ has a stray wordspace after በ-; read ወበእከዮሙ ‘and through their evil’. ክሕደቶሙ ‘their denial’. ይሰቅልዎ ‘they will crucify him’ (3mp imperfect + -ኦ).

sentences.i: And if he were not crucified, he would not be your salvation, for he is crucified without sin and rises without corruption; and on this account he goes down to you into Sheol, and tears down its walls (?), to save you, to bring you out, and to have mercy on all of you;
sentences.n: ወሶበሰ ‘and if, indeed’ (ሶበ ‘when, if’ + -ሰ). ኢተሰቅለ is the passive (tä-stem) of ሰቀለ ‘crucify’; ኢኮነ (3ms perfect) ‘he would not be’, the second እመ ‘if’ leading the second half of the sentence (?). ይሰቀል (passive of ሰቀለ) and ይትነሣእ (tä-stem of ንሥአ) are 3ms imperfects (‘is crucified’, ‘rises’). ዘእንበለ ‘without’ takes a noun: ኀጢአት ‘sin’, ሙስና ‘corruption’ (compare Acts 2:27, Psalm 16:10). ወበእንተዝ ‘and on this account’. ይወርድ ‘he descends’; ኀቤከሙ = ኀበ (stem ኀቤ-) + -ከሙ ‘to you (pl.)’; ሲኦል ‘Sheol, the place of the dead’, the descent to the dead (compare 1 Peter 3:19). ይነሥት ‘he tears down’; አረፋቲሃ is plural of አረፍት plus -ሃ ‘its’, ‘walls’ being a guess (?). ያድኅንክሙ, ያውፅእክሙ, ይምሐርክሙ are 3ms subjunctives with -ክሙ ‘you’, after ከመ ‘that’; ለኵልክሙ ‘to all of you’ stresses the object.

sentences.l: Those-who was-carried the-pearl in your-wombs you-will-be-saved with your-wives, and-there-is-not one-who is-lost from-you, from-your-father Adam until he-who-comes, your-kinsman Joachim, and-from-Eve, your-mother, his-wife, Adam’s, until Noah and-his-wife Termiza, until Terah and-his-wife Aminya, and-until Abraham and-his-wife Sarah, and-until Isaac and-his-wife Rebecca, and-until Jacob and-his-wife Leah, and-until Judah and-his-bride Tamar, and-until your-father and-his-wife Bathsheba, and-until yourself and-Terbana your-wife, and-until Jeroboam your-son and-Amisa his-wife, and-until Joachim, who comes, your-kinsman, and-his-wife Hannah;
sentences.i: You in whose wombs the pearl was carried will be saved, with your wives, and none of you will be lost: from your father Adam to your kinsman Joachim, who is yet to come; and from Eve, your mother, the wife of Adam, to Noah and his wife Termiza; to Terah and his wife Aminya; to Abraham and his wife Sarah; to Isaac and his wife Rebecca; to Jacob and his wife Leah; to Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar; to your father and his wife Bathsheba; to you and your wife Terbana; to Jeroboam your son and his wife Amisa; and to Joachim, your kinsman who is to come, and his wife Hannah;
sentences.n: This unit is a single long list, over the usual length, but it contains no ፤ at which to cut it. እለ ተጸውረት ባሕርይ ‘those in whom the pearl was carried’ (ተጸውረት is the passive of ጾረ ‘carry, bear’, 3fs, with ባሕርይ as subject); ትድኅኑ is 2mp imperfect (of ድኅነ ‘be safe’) (‘you will be saved’); ወአልቦ ዘይትሀጐል ‘and there is none who is lost’ (ሀጐለ ‘perish’, tä-stem). አንስቲያክሙ ‘your wives’ (plural of ብእሲት). እስከ ‘as far as, until’ marks each step of the list, with ወ- ‘and’ on the later ones. ዘይመጽእ ‘who comes’ means ‘who is still to come’. ዘመድ ‘kinsman’; እምከ = እም ‘mother’ + -ከ. ብእሲቱ ‘his wife’, መርዓቱ ‘his bride, daughter-in-law’ (Genesis 38). Joachim is spelled two ways (ኤያቄም, ኢዮአቄም); in Christian tradition he and Hannah (Anna) are Mary’s parents, though this text does not say so. The wives Termiza, Aminya, Terbana and Amisa are not named in Genesis or Kings; I give the names as the Geʿez has them.

sentences.i: All of you who carried the pearl: none of you will be lost, from your men to your women. You will not be lost, you who carried the pearl.
sentences.n: ኵልክሙ = ኵሉ ‘all’ + -ክሙ ‘of you’. ጾርክምዋ = ጾርክሙ ‘you carried’ (2mp perfect of ጾረ) + -ዋ ‘her’, with ለባሕርይ repeating the object, as in ፈጠራ ለሔዋን above. ተባዕትክሙ ‘your males’ (ተባዕት ‘male’ + -ክሙ), እስከ አንስቲያክሙ ‘right to your women’. ኢትትሀጐሉ is the 2mp imperfect, negated, of the tä-stem of ሀጐለ. The unit ends the part with the promise of salvation to every ancestor, men and women alike.

glossary.ተፈጥረት: ተፈጥረ — she was created (3fs perfect, passive of ፈጠረ; subject ታቦት) · 'it was brought about' with fem. subject ስሕተተ (ስሕተተ ተባዕት ተፈጥረት 'the error of the man came about') · with the feminine noun መደኀኒትክሙ 'your salvation' as subject
glossary.ቱ: እሙንቱ — (?) final syllable of እሙንቱ 'they are' split off by the wordspace, so እሙን ቱ ≈ 'they are' (?); not a separate word
glossary.ትከውን: ኮነ — you will be (2ms imperfect) · also 3fs 'she/it becomes, is' (እንተ ትከውን ሲሳየ 'which is food')
glossary.ትድኅኑ: ድኅነ — you (pl.) will be saved (2mp imperfect, G, d-ḫ-n)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀቤከሙ: ኀበ — to you (pl.) (preposition + -ከሙ '2mp you', form ኀቤ-)
glossary.ኀጢአት: ኀጢአት — sin (noun, fem.; here genitive after construct ርስሐተ 'defilement of sin') · after ዘእንበለ (ዘእንበለ ኀጢአት 'without sin')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አረፋቲሃ: አረፍት — its walls (?) (plural አረፋት + -ሃ '3fs its'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.አበዊከ: አብ — your fathers (noun, plural አበው + -ka '2ms your')
glossary.አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
glossary.አንስቲያክሙ: ብእሲት — your women, your wives (plural አንስት + -ያ- + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.አዳም: አዳም — Adam · (?) as predicate in ወኵሉ ርእየቱ አዳም, probably an adjective 'pleasing, comely' (from the sense; unconfirmed); 'Adam' as the first perfect man also possible · Adam, in ዘመደ አዳም 'the kin of Adam' (the human race; ch. 53) · (?) as predicate in ኢኮነ አዳም 'it is not comely' (of ላሕይ 'appearance'), read like the earlier predicate use, 'pleasing, comely' (?); 'ruddy' (cf. አደመ 'be red') is the alternative (?)
glossary.አድራሚ: አድራሚ — Adrami (?) (name of a son of Solomon (?); form obscure, possibly corrupt) (?)
glossary.ኢሖረት: ሖረ — she did not go (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ኢሰቀልዎ: ሰቀለ — they did not crucify him (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, s-q-l, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢቦአት: ቦአ — she did not enter (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ኢተሰቅለ: ተሰቅለ — he was not crucified (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, passive tä-stem of ሰቀለ)
glossary.ኢትትሀጐሉ: ተሀጕለ — you (pl.) will not be lost (ኢ- 'not' + 2mp imperfect, tä-stem of ሀጕለ)
glossary.ኢክሕዲ: ክሕደ — they did not deny (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G; ending -ዲ for -ዱ (?))
glossary.ኢክሕድዎ: ክሕደ — they did not deny him (ኢ- 'not' + 3mp perfect, G, k-ḥ-d, + -ዎ '3ms him')
glossary.ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
glossary.ኢወፅአት: ወጽአ — she did not go out (ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.እመ: እመ — if (conjunction) · whether (ጐንደይኩ እመ ትገብእ 'I waited whether she would return')
glossary.እሙን: እሙን — faithful, trustworthy, sure (adjective) · first half of a word split by the wordspace, እሙን ፡ ቱ ≈ እሙንቱ 'they are' (?)
glossary.እሙንቱሰ: እሙንቱ — they indeed, they for their part (3mp pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.እምቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, prior to · 'from before' (እምቅድመ ገጾሙ 'from before their faces')
glossary.እምተባዕትክሙ: ተባዕት — from your men, males (እም- 'from' + noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.እምአቡከ: አብ — from your father (እም- 'from' + noun + -ከ '2ms your', form አቡ-)
glossary.እምከርሠ: ከርሥ — from the womb of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምከርሥከ: ከርሥ — from your womb (እም- 'from' + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እምዐፅመ: ዐፅም — from the bone of (እም- 'from' + noun, construct)
glossary.እምዘርእከ: ዘርእ — from your seed (እም- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እስከነ: እስከ — until (conjunction before a verb; the ending -ነ is unexplained (?))
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')

glossary.ከርሥክሙ: ከርሥ — your wombs, your bellies (noun + -ክሙ '2mp your')
glossary.ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
glossary.ወልቡናከ: ልቡና — and your understanding (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወመርዓቱ: መርዓት — and his bride, daughter-in-law (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወመንክረ: መንክር — and marvel, wonder (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወሶበሰ: ሶበ — and if, and when (ወ- 'and' + conjunction + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወበ: በ — and through, and by (ወ- 'and' + preposition በ-, split from the following noun by the wordspace)
glossary.ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
glossary.ወበደኃሪ: ደኃሪ — and in the latter, last
glossary.ወብእሲቱ: ብእሲት — and his wife (ወ- + noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወቦአት: ቦአ — and she entered (ወ- + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወተርባና: ተርባና — and Terbana (ወ- + proper name; Solomon's wife)
glossary.ወትሑታነ: ትሑት — and humble ones (ወ- + adj., plural, accusative)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአሚሳ: አሚሳ — and Amisa (ወ- + proper name; Jeroboam's wife)
glossary.ወአብዳን: አብድ — and fools (ወ- + noun/adj., plural in -ን)
glossary.ወኢሖረት: ሖረ — and she did not go (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3fs perfect, G)
glossary.ወእምሔዋን: ሔዋን — and from Eve (ወ- + እም- 'from' + proper name)
glossary.ወእምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወእምያዕቆብ: ያዕቆብ — and from Jacob (ወ- + እም- 'from' + proper name)
glossary.ወእምይሁዳኒ: ይሁዳ — and from Judah too (ወ- + እም- 'from' + proper name + -ኒ 'also, too')
glossary.ወእምይስሐቅኒ: ይስሐቅ — and from Isaac too (ወ- + እም- 'from' + proper name + -ኒ 'also, too')
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወዘርእከ: ዘርእ — and your seed (ወ- + noun + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ወዝኁራነ: ዝኁር — and haughty ones (?) (ወ- + adj. plural accusative; sense and lemma uncertain)
glossary.ወያውፅእክሙ: አውፅአ — and he brings you out (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, causative of ወጽአ, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — and he loves (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, causative of ፈቀረ; አፍቀረ is the ordinary verb 'love')
glossary.ወይምሐርክሙ: መሐረ — and he has mercy on you (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, m-ḥ-r, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይትነሣእ: ተንሥአ — and he rises (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ንሥአ)
glossary.ወይነሥት: ነሠተ — and he tears down, pulls down (ወ- + 3ms imperfect)
glossary.ወገብአት: ገብአ — she returned (3fs perfect, G, g-b-ʾ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወፅአት: ወጽአ — she went out (3fs perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ዕንቈ: ዕንቍ — jewel, precious stone (noun, construct 'stones of'; ዕንቈ ባሕርያተ 'pearl-stones')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘይመጽእ: መጽአ — who comes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ዘይትሀጐል: ተሀጕለ — who is lost, who perishes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ሀጕለ)
glossary.ዘይትወለድ: ተወልደ — who is born (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ወለደ)
glossary.ዘይንእስኒ: ንእሰ — the one who is small, young (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect of ንእሰ 'be small' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ዘይገብር: ገብረ — who does, who works (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ዜናሁ: ዜና — his report, news, story (noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.የአምኑ: አምነ — they believe (3mp imperfect, G, ʾ-m-n)
glossary.ያድኅንከ: አድኀነ — he saves you (3ms subjunctive, causative of ድኅነ 'be safe', + -ከ '2ms you')
glossary.ያድኅንክሙ: አድኀነ — he saves you (pl.) (3ms subjunctive, causative of ድኅነ, + -ክሙ '2mp you')
glossary.ይመጽእ: መጽአ — he comes (3ms subjunctive, G, m-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ይሬእዩ: ርእየ — they see (3mp imperfect/subjunctive, G, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ይሰቀል: ተሰቅለ — he is crucified, is to be crucified (3ms imperfect, passive of ሰቀለ)

glossary.ይትወለዲ: ተወልደ — they are born (3mp subjunctive (same form as the imperfect), tä-stem of ወለደ; ending -ዲ for -ዱ (?))
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day') · 'she' restating the subject, a resumptive pronoun before a noun (ይእቲ ባሕርይ 'she, the pearl')
glossary.ይወርድ: ወረደ — it will descend (3ms imperfect, G, w-r-d)
glossary.ይጸልእ: ጸልአ — he hates (3ms imperfect, G, ṣ-l-ʾ)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ጸንሐት: ጸንሐ — she waited, remained (3fs perfect, G, ṣ-n-ḥ)
glossary.ጾርክምዋ: ጾረ — you (pl.) carried her (2mp perfect, G, ṣ-w-r, + -ዋ '3fs her')
glossary.ፈጠራ: ፈጠረ — he created her (3ms perfect, G, f-ṭ-r; + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.፬: ፬ — 4, spoken አርባዕቱ (ʾarbaʿtu) 'four'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'four' (ውስተ ፬ መሳምክቲሃ 'in her four supports'; spoken አርባዕ ʾarbaʿ before a feminine plural, አርባዕቱ with a masculine)
glossary.፭: ፭ — 5, spoken ኀምስቱ (ḫaməstu) 'five'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'five' (፭ ስሑታን 'five erring ones'; spoken ኀምስቱ before a masculine)
glossary.፮: ፮ — 6, spoken ስድስቱ (sədstu) 'six'; chapter number (numeral) · count: ፮ ዓመተ 'six years', ፮ ሲሕ 'six thousand (?)'
glossary.፷፰: ፷፰ — 68, spoken ስሳ ወሰመንቱ (səssa wä-sämäntu) 'sixty-eight'; chapter number (numeral)
